text:
tara: All-hands in 20. Quick ops note — if the live stream starts stuttering, flip to backup encoder (encoder-2) and start the local ISO recorder. Slides remote might be flaky; @sam_media be ready to advance manually. We'll shorten Q&A to ~15m (leadership 10m + 5m lightning). I'll post final Qs after the intro. :eyes:
sam_media: On it. encoder-2 is staged and warm. ISO recorder r01 has 2.5TB free. I'll bring a spare remote battery.
leo_ops: obs-monitor just reported a 3% keyframe drop on encoder-1. If that hits >5% we flip. I'll keep an eye on CPU and network.
ops-bot: Alert: encoder-1 keyframe_drop=3.2% window=60s
devon_sre: If we do switch, remember to update the stream key in the mux config: `stream.key: REDWOOD_AH_KEY`. Pushing a k8s secret patch now so the hot-swap is seamless.
nina_prod: For Q&A: please ask people to prefix with a 1-line context so we can route to the right leader faster. I'll pin the Q&A thread link after the intro and keep an ordered list.
rhonda_eng: Heads-up: roadmap slides 8->12 are dense. @tara do you want me to trim experimental benches to keep things snappy?
tara: Yes — please remove the deep-bench slide and keep the Dedicated rollout + metrics. We'll take bench followups offline with Platform.
sam_media: Obs hotkey is working but deck remote battery at ~20%. Will have manual fallback (`pgup/pgdn`) and a spare.
devon_sre: If captions fail, restart the caption worker with: ```
kubectl -n media rollout restart deployment/captions-worker
```
leo_ops: Noted. If local recorder drops, trigger the ingest fallback so we still have the last 10m chunk: `kubectl -n media exec -it ingest-backup -- /bin/trigger-save`
nina_prod: :thumbsup: I'll draft a short post-all-hands summary with timestamps and actions (Q&A + followups) and share in #all-hands-followups.
tara: Thanks everyone. Quick behavioral note — keep live answers short and on-point. We'll do a 5-min dry run at T-10 to smoke out any remaining issues.
sam_media: :wave: doing mic + captions test now. @tara can you confirm audio/levels?
tara: Loud & clear. Go ahead.
